about_the_game:
🪐 About the Game

Strap on your helmet and get ready for a fast-paced cosmic arcade adventure!
Take control of an astronaut exploring deep space, collecting stars, dodging hazards, and navigating through floating asteroid debris. This isn’t just a flight — it’s a challenge!

🚀 Flight on the Edge

To move around, the astronaut uses a jetpack that allows him to fly and maneuver between asteroids. But there's a catch — energy is limited. Overuse will leave you drifting helplessly in space. To recharge, you’ll need to extract energy from asteroids, making route planning a key part of survival.

Every decision counts: Will you risk everything for that extra star, or head to the nearest energy source?

☄️ Key Features:

  • 🌟 Zero-gravity arcade platformer gameplay

  • 🔋 Strategic resource management — your jetpack fuel is your lifeline

  • 🕹️ Fast, responsive controls focused on precision and timing

  • 🕳️ Avoid black holes, outsmart alien creatures, and don’t vanish into the void

  • 🌌 Explore mysterious zones, gather stars, and climb the high score ladder

🎮 Are You Ready?

Only the fastest and sharpest players will survive the chaos of space.
Jump, maneuver, survive — and remember: every star brings you closer to victory!
